failure_summary.description: Calls used incorrect or incomplete values, selectors, locale settings, geographic fields, parameter groups, or target-to-call mapping.
A neighboring capability was used instead of a tool that directly covered the requested source or verification property.

patch.reasoning: The recurring issues are already covered by the skill’s schema-validation, canonical-value, geographic-hierarchy, distinct-target, and endpoint-scope rules. Adding another general rule would duplicate existing guidance; some expected API-specific values cannot be safely inferred from the listed schemas.
